title: A CLICK IN ONE WINDOW NO LONGER SHUTS THE BACKPACK OF THE OTHER PLAYER
why: On one PC both windows are played at once, so the player 2 backpack is opened by its controller while the other window has focus, and the player 1 backpack can be opened by keys handed over from the player 2 window. Any click that moved focus between the windows shut the backpack of the window that lost or took focus and dropped the item being moved. A focus change in a two-window game now leaves the backpack open and keeps a controller drag; a mouse drag is still dropped, and one window alone, the cursor reset key and a hidden tab still close the backpack as before.
